page.overview:
Who is Fushi?

Fushi is a man of average appearance with short light-colored hair and grey eyes.

Fushi appears to be considerate as he didn't bring his fiend partner to a public party because they're too scary.

He is hinted to be proud of his high IQ score of 134 as he remembers the exact number.

At some point Fushi was drunkenly kissed by Himeno.
